about_the_game:
Buy F1® 25 Iconic Edition Upgrade to receive:
  • Lewis Hamilton Iconic Pack
  • APXGP Team Pack (ends July 11)*
  • F1® World Bumper Pack
  • 18,000 PitCoin virtual currency to spend in-game
This Story is Yours: Leave your mark on the world of racing in F1® 25, the official video game of the 2025 FIA Formula One World Championship™. Create your story and run your F1® dynasty in the revamped My Team mode. Choose your path through the thrilling third chapter of Braking Point, with alternative scenarios at key moments in the plot. Take center stage in your very own F1® action movie.

*This promotional offer ends July 11, 2025 at 15:00 UTC. Valid for new purchases of F1® 25 Iconic Edition or F1® 25 Iconic Edition Digital Upgrade from the EA app (ea.com/ea-app), EA.com store, or participating retailers. Offer includes APXGP Team Pack (play as the APXGP team in Driver Career and My Team) (“Bonus Content”). Bonus Content for digital product entitled automatically after content has been released. Bonus Content will not be available if you redeem after May 30, 2026. Requires F1® 25 (sold separately), EA account, internet connection & all game updates. Limit 1 per account. Offer has no cash value and may not be substituted, exchanged, or sold for cash, goods, or services. May not be combined with other offers or prepaid card redeemable for the applicable content unless expressly authorized by EA. Void where prohibited, taxed, or restricted by law.
